paragraphs.text: A trial ledger for factor research: counts how many factors you have tried, and refuses to judge one
without that number. MCP server + dsh plugin.
alphaledger
A trial ledger for factor research.

Every factor you evaluate is a draw from a lottery. alphaledger counts the draws —
and it will not j
udge one without knowing how many came before it.
## The problem, in one table
| | What you see | What you conclude |

| **One factor, on its own** | RankIC `0.0105`, t `3.03`, p `0.0027` | Significant. Ship it. |
| **T
he same factor, 200 draws deep** | the same numbers, plus `p_family = 0.346` | It is luck. Drop it.
e same factor, 200 draws deep** | the same numbers, plus `p_family = 0.346` | It is luck. Drop it. |
Nothing about the factor changed. Only the count did.
That count is the one thing an agent cannot keep. A researcher tests five ideas a day and remembers
them. An agent tests two hundred an hour, and every session starts with a blank context.
## See it in twenty seconds
One command, on a panel of 300 names × 250 dates where **every factor is pure noise**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A RankIC of 1% is an ordinary magnitude for a **real** factor, so the size of the effect cannot tell
you whether it is real. The only discriminating information is how many times you drew.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Four tools sit on top of that loop:
| Tool | Question it answers | Cost |

| `fingerprint` | Have I tried this factor before? | free — no trial consumed |
| `evaluate` | What

is its RankIC, and what is its trial number? | one trial |
| `gate` | Does it survive the family cor

rection, and how far off was it? | free |
| `ledger_stats` | How much have I tried, and where am I g
oing in circles? | free |
A `PASS` requires `p_family ≤ α`. `p_single` is reported and is never evidence.
## Install

alphaledger is an MCP server, wrapped in a four-file dsh plugin. One implementation,
two ways in; no
thing leaves the machine and no API key is involved.
**DeepSeek Harness** — one command:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle only writes the config that launches the server. If you would rather see it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Claude Code, Codex, or any other MCP client:**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Tools appear as `mcp__alphaledger__evaluate`, `mcp__alphaledger__gate`, and so on.

Both routes need `uv` once (`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`),
because dsh delibera

tely does not manage Python environments. The server is on PyPI;
the npm bundle is not published yet

, so for now the dsh route installs from the
checkout: `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh/alphaledg

er`. That is the ordinary
`pnpm add` path, not a fallback — it was run against dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with a

n isolated
`DSH_HOME`: the command exits 0, `dsh-alphaledger` is added to `dsh.profile.bundles`,
and

its MCP entry appears in `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config`. Publishing to npm
would only buy the
shorter spelling `dsh plugin add dsh-alphaledger`.
> Dependencies are numpy and the standard library. scipy would double the install and add seconds to
a cold start, and the two things we needed from it — rank correlation and Student-t tails — are a f
ew dozen lines. See `docs/METHOD.md`.
## Three things the ledger refuses to do

**It will not count `rank(x)` as a new factor.**
Identity is the factor's rank pattern, hashed as in
tegers. `x`, `rank(x)`, `log(x)` and `2x+3` rank identically, so they are one trial with four evalua
tions. Flipping the sign is the same trial too — recorded as a `sign_flip`, which is the cheapest wa
y a family quietly grows.

**It will not merge near-duplicates.**
Two factors correlating at 0.97 are reported as `NEAR_DUPLICA
TE` and left alone. Merging them would let *"I only changed one parameter"* escape the count, which
is the entire problem.

**It will not pass a leaked factor.**
A factor ranked identically to the forward return is `LABEL_CO
NTAMINATION`, checked **before** significance — because that is the one case where the numbers look
NATION`, checked **before** significance — because that is the one case where the numbers look best.
## What it does not do
No data layer — you bring a panel, and an akshare adapter is planned. No backtest engine, no portfol
io construction, no UI. It judges one factor's IC series and keeps the books, and that is all.
## Documentation

| `docs/METHOD.md` | Every formula, with the function and the test that pins it |
| `docs/TOOLS.md`

| Schemas, error codes, host wiring |
| `docs/AUDIT.md` | Three existing dsh quant tools, read at so

urce level |
| `docs/CALIBRATION.md` | Measured false-positive rate and power |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Wha
t shipped, what is v0.2 |
## Status
**0.1.0.** On PyPI as `alphaledger-mcp`. The npm bundle is not published yet. Statistics, identity,
ledger and the MCP surface are implemented and tested: 104 tests, `ruff` and `mypy` clean, false-pos
itive rate 8.3% (1 in 12 studies), power 4 of 4 on a planted IC of 0.03.
v0.2: akshare adapter, one-shot OOS test lock, full look-ahead perturbation.
